prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single shared texture atlas master for modular 2D prison wall tiles.
Input image: the original warm soft illustrated cafeteria portal is MATERIAL/PALETTE reference only; especially old horizontal wing, not its gate, pillars, silhouette or background.
Primary request: Paint ONE coherent, edge-to-edge rectangular wall-material master. Every horizontal tile, vertical coping, L corner, endface, jamb and lintel will be sampled from this same PNG. Do not illustrate separate objects or a finished room. This is a source texture sheet with three aligned horizontal material bands and genuine edge-to-edge solid pixels, no transparent background.
Composition: landscape1536×1024, filled entirely. It has three contiguous horizontal bands:
A. upper approximately21%: pale warm gray/ivory weathered limestone coping. One thin, gently irregular vertical mortar seam at the horizontal center splits two broad stone blocks. Stone texture is soft mottled mineral grain, faint chips and hairline wear. No thick outlines around blocks. No strong bevel or rim frame; this is the stone SURFACE used both as top and side with engine shading.
B. middle approximately49%: muted gray-beige plaster wall surface. Same underlying soft limestone grain/wear scale as upperband, only slightly duller/darker, subtle very sparse hairline cracks. One large continuous unframed stucco panel with no vertical division.
C. lower approximately30%: desaturated medium charcoal/slate gray masonry plinth from the same stone family, two broad blocks with one thin vertical seam at center. Not black, no saturated blue. Material grain density and line softness match the upperband.
A/B and B/C boundaries are straight horizontal and fine, no thick ink lines, bevelled picture frame, white halo or drop shadow. Vertical band boundaries approximately21%/70% of canvas height. Left and right endpoints match for horizontal seamless repetition: even color at corresponding heights, no dark side border, no terminal frame. Top and bottom are clean continuation crops too, no final border. Surface marks stay quiet so repeating at64world units does not look like decorative repeated stamps.
Style: precisely match source old wall's restrained hand-painted cartoon prison limestone: warm desaturated colors, gentle soft dark contour, medium broad stones, subtle larger grain, sparse cracks. Avoid the hard outlines, tiny dense mortar blocks, overly bright yellow stone and detailed noisy speckles of the rejected corner. Texture should be readable at game camera scale, NOT photorealistic or pixel art. Neutral shared diffuse top-left illumination; no direction-specific shadows baked into the stone swatch, engine handles face direction.
Constraints: all1536×1024 pixels contain material; no outside border/margin, background, floor, labels, text, decorative scene, pillars, gate, L-shaped silhouettes, humans or objects. Exactly one maternal texture used universally; broad stones and consistent low contrast.
